privacy: Aggregate whitelist only; no questions, answers, resume, JD, keys or SDK messages.
acceptance: Latency targets observed in the finite core sample; quality coverage and zero-factual-error targets NOT met.
measurementLimits: Virtual renderer IPC is not physical screen latency.
Physical microphone, loopback and OBS/Tencent capture validation waived by user; unverified.
